items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I also worked with the Orchestra Metropolitan as an addition under Demetri Metropolis. I played contrabassoon.

ctx.x: You never found another town that you could actually live and be comfortable in?

No, no, Puerto Rico we found very good. We enjoyed it, and my young children were born there and I had a good opportunity there -- I worked in the symphony there. And at that time I'd had -- I'd done a few concerts. I did one as an addition in the Philharmonic. I also worked with the Orchestra Metropolitan as an addition under Demetri Metropolis. I played contrabassoon. But because I was a bassoonist, they used me as a showcase. And they put me -- I also went in Radio City later on as a showcase. They said, 'Oh,…
